object_description: interlocking rectangular volumes with a raised upper floor
design_condition: The volumes respect differing contextual scales, frame a connected public park landscape, and integrate the sports field and river edge while parking reduces the outdoor-space potential.

positive.statement: The connection with the context is cleverly achieved through a generously designed public outdoor space.
The new building volume relates geometrically and volumetrically precisely to the town hall.
The permeable organization of the school complex is functionally and architecturally convincing.
The entrance hall can be used in a variety of ways as a meeting area, lounge, or school auditorium.
The organization of the teaching floor is convincing and allows flexible, sustainable use.
The gym benefits from natural exposure and is operationally well organized.
The concept creates spacious public outdoor spaces with overlapping potential uses.

negative.statement: The location and number of outdoor parking spaces compromise the intended park landscape and river-area upgrade.
The escape balconies and stairs should have a greater influence on the architectural appearance and should also serve normal school operations.
The compact-looking project has a comparatively large cubature and building footprint.
The expected costs are likely to be above average compared with the other projects.
The large volume below terrain and massive base suggest a high grey-energy requirement.
The multi-purpose room integrated into the oversized entrance hall offers potential for cost optimization.
